clauses:
1. DEFINITIONS & INTERPRETATION
1.1 “Principal’s’ Obligation’s” means all monies, interest, default fees, charges, taxes, and legal recovery costs now or hereafter due, owing, or incurred by the Borrower to the Lender under the loan facility.
1.2 “Maximum Guarantee Amount” means principal’s’ obligations’ value), plus any accruing interest, fees, and enforcement expenses properly incurred by the Lender.
 2. GUARANTEE AND INDEMNITY
 2.1 Guarantee: The Guarantor’s’ hereby jointly and severally, unconditionally and irrevocably guarantee’s’ the prompt payment and discharge on demand of all Principal's Obligations and Maximum Guarantee Amount owed by the Borrower to the Lender.
2.2 Indemnity: As an independent primary obligation, the Guarantor’s’ agree to fully indemnify and hold harmless the Lender against any loss, liability, cost, or expense incurred as a result of any failure by the Borrower to pay or perform the Principal’s Obligations.

 3. CONTINUING SECURITY & JOINT LIABILITY
 3.1 Continuing Security: This Guarantee shall be a continuing security for all the Borrower's Obligations and shall not be discharged or affected by any intermediate payment, settlement of account, or the insolvency/liquidation of the Borrower.
3.2 Joint & Several Liability: The liability of the Guarantors’ is joint and several. The Lender may enforce its rights against the/either Guarantor without first enforcing against the Borrower or exhausting other securities.
 4. LIMITATION OF GUARANTEE & RECOVERIES
 4.1 The aggregate principal recoverable from the Guarantors under this Guarantee shall not exceed UGX ........................./= (Uganda Shillings   Only)( Original Borrowed Sum), together with:
•  Accrued interest on the principal amount at the agreed rate up to the date of full payment; and
•  All legal, recovery, stamping, and enforcement costs incurred by the Lender in enforcing this Guarantee.
 5. DISCHARGES AND RELEASES AVOIDED (PROTECTION CLAUSES)
 5.1 Non-Impairment of Liability: The liability of the Guarantor’s’ shall remain fully binding and shall not be impaired, released, or discharged by:
5.1.1  Any extension of time, indulgence, or forbearance granted by the Lender to the Borrower;
5.1.2  Any variation, amendment, renewal, or restructuring of the loan agreement;
5.1.3  The Lender releasing, compounding, or failing to perfect any other security or guarantee held for the loan;
5.1.4  Any death, incapacity, bankruptcy, or insolvency of any Guarantor’s’ or the Borrower;
5.1.5  Any act or omission by the Lender which, but for this provision, might operate to discharge the Guarantor’s’.
5.2 Reinstatement of Guarantee:
Any discharge or release given by the Lender shall be void if any payment or security received by the Lender is subsequently set aside or avoided under insolvency, bankruptcy, or liquidation laws.
 6. CLAIMS & WAIVER OF RIGHTS BY GUARANTORS
 6.1 Until all Principal’s Obligations are fully discharged, the Guarantors shall not, in competition with or to the detriment of the Lender:
Claim any set-off, counterclaim, or right of subrogation against the Borrower;
Claim or prove in insolvency/liquidation of the Borrower in competition with the Lender; Claim any contribution from any co-surety in respect of payments made under this
• 
• 
•  Guarantee.

 7. SUSPENSE ACCOUNT & EVIDENCE OF DEBT
 7.1 Suspense Account: The Lender may place and keep any monies recovered under this Guarantee in a separate suspense account without immediate obligation to apply the same towards discharging the debt, to preserve the Lender's right to prove for the full debt against the Borrower.
7.2 Conclusive Evidence: A certificate issued by an authorized officer of the Lender stating the amount of the Principal's Obligations due shall be conclusive evidence of the debt binding on the Guarantor’s’.
 8. ASSIGNMENT & TRANSFER
 8.1 Rights of the Lender: The Lender shall have a full and unfettered right to assign or transfer the whole or any part of the benefit of this Guarantee without the consent of the Guarantor’s’. The expression "Lender" shall include all assignees and successors in title.
8.2 Restriction on Guarantors: The Guarantors shall not have the right to assign or transfer any of their rights or obligations under this Agreement.
 9. BORROWER AS A PARTNERSHIP
 9.1 If the Borrower is a partnership, this Guarantee shall extend to all monies and liabilities owing to the Lender prior to any change or dissolution of the partnership, and shall continue in full force notwithstanding the retirement, death, or admission of any partner.
 10. NOTICES AND SERVICE
 10.1 Service of Notices: Any notice or demand required to be given hereunder shall be in writing and deemed effectively served:
•  (a) When delivered by hand to the address of the recipient; or
•  (b) Three (3) days after posting by registered mail, provided proof of posting is retained.
10.2 Multiple Guarantors: Any notice or demand served on any one of the Guarantors shall be deemed as effective service on all Guarantors.
10.3 Death of a Guarantor: In the event of the death of a Guarantor, notice or demand addressed to the deceased or their personal representatives at their last known address shall remain fully valid and binding on the estate of the deceased until the Lender receives formal written notice of probate/letters of administration.
 11. GOVERNING LAW & JURISDICTION
 11.1 This Guarantee shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Republic of Uganda.
11.2 The Guarantor’s’ irrevocably submit to the jurisdiction of the Courts of Uganda for the enforcement of this Guarantee.
